## [Keys — Zentrix Check documentation](https://zentrix.company/en/check/docs/llaves.html)

How keys are tracked with Zentrix Check: the key ring with its QR code, who takes each key, when it comes back and what to do if a key isn’t returned on time.

### Keys

Every key ring has a label with a code. You scan it when the key goes out and when it comes back, and you sign with your PIN.

### Before you start

Keys are turned on site by site. If you don’t see the Llave (Key) tile under Registrar (Register), your site doesn’t use them yet.

Every key ring carries a label with a code that the office prints from Odoo. You scan the code; you don’t type it. Typing it by hand doesn’t work: «Escanea el llavero. Escribir el código no sirve.» (“Scan the key ring. Typing the code doesn’t work.”)

### Handing out a key

- Tap «Registrar» › «Llave» (Register › Key), or «Escanear» (Scan) on Hoy (Today). Inside the frame it says «Apunta al llavero» (“Point at the key ring”).

- Scan the key ring’s label. The key appears with its name.

- «¿Quién la lleva?» (“Who’s taking it?”) Tap their name. The list comes from Odoo. The people who take that key most often are at the top.

- Sign with your PIN. At the end: «Salió» (“Left”). The voice says «Llave entregada.» (“Key handed over.”)

### If the person isn’t on the list

Tap Otra persona (Someone else). The app says «Llama al supervisor antes de entregarla» (“Call the supervisor before handing it over”). If the supervisor says yes, tap Sale igual (Release anyway) and sign. You don’t type the name: it’s logged as «Otra persona» and the office gets an alert.

### Taking a key back

- Scan the key ring. From Registrar (Register), from Hoy (Today), or under Hoy › Adentro › «Llaves afuera» (Today › Inside › Keys out) by tapping the key and then Escanear (Scan).

- «¿Vienen todas?» (“Are they all here?”) If the ring holds several keys, count them and tap Sí (Yes) or No. If you tap No, take a photo of the key ring and tap Siguiente (Next).

- Tap «Firmar» (Sign) and enter your PIN. At the end: «Volvió» (“Returned”). The voice says «Llave devuelta.» (“Key returned.”)

A key ring that comes back incomplete stays marked «Incompleto» (“Incomplete”) until the office sorts it out.

### If the key ring has no label

In the viewfinder, tap Sin etiqueta (No label). The app says «El llavero no tiene etiqueta. Llama al supervisor.» (“The key ring has no label. Call the supervisor.”)

To take back a key with no label, find it under Hoy › Adentro › «Llaves afuera» and log it from there with Sin etiqueta. It’s recorded as an unverified return.

### If you see a message

Message What to do

«No es llavero» (“Not a key ring”) That code belongs to something else. Tap Otra vez (Again) and point at the key ring.

«No la conocemos» (“We don’t know this one”) Odoo doesn’t know that key ring. Call the supervisor.

«Escanea el llavero» (“Scan the key ring”) You typed the code. Scan it with the camera.

### Keys out

Under Hoy › Adentro (Today › Inside), «Llaves afuera» (“Keys out”) shows every key that has been handed out, who has it and since what time. If a key has been out for a long time, the time turns amber and reads «hace muchas horas» (“many hours ago”). It’s only a heads-up: you don’t need to do anything in the app.


---

## [Incidents and calls — Zentrix Check documentation](https://zentrix.company/en/check/docs/novedades.html)

How to log an incident at the gate with Zentrix Check, call the supervisor from the app, use the site’s phone list and record who authorized a decision.

### Incidents and calls

Anything that happens at the gate and isn’t a truck is logged as an incident. And when something is serious, the app tells you who to call.

### Log an incident

An incident is something that happened at the gate and doesn’t depend on a truck or a document: a power outage, a damaged door, an intruder, a theft. Incidents are turned on per site: if you don’t see the Novedad (Incident) tile in Registrar (Register), your site doesn’t use them yet.

- Tap «Registrar» › «Novedad» (Register › Incident).

- «¿Qué pasó?» (“What happened?”) Tap the picture. Odoo loads the incident types for your site.

- «¿Es grave?» (“Is it serious?”) Tap Sí (Yes) or No. Serious means, for example, a theft or someone inside.

- Take photos, if they help. Up to three, and only of things: no people. You can continue without a photo.

- «Dilo corto» (“Keep it short”). Two or three words. Type them, or tap the keyboard’s microphone and speak. The app doesn’t record audio.

- Sign with your PIN. At the end: «Novedad anotada» (“Incident logged”). Tap Hoy (Today).

You choose what happened by tapping a picture.

No names or ID numbers
Don’t write names, ID numbers or phone numbers. If you type six digits in a row, the app won’t let you continue: «Sin números largos. No escribas cédulas ni teléfonos.» (“No long numbers. Don’t write ID numbers or phone numbers.”)

If Odoo has no types loaded: «Odoo no tiene tipos de novedad en esta sede. Llama al supervisor.» (“Odoo has no incident types for this site. Call the supervisor.”)

### Serious incident

If you answer Sí (Yes) to «¿Es grave?» (“Is it serious?”), the screen turns red: «Novedad grave» (“Serious incident”) and «Llama al supervisor ahora» (“Call the supervisor now”). Call right from that screen.

When the incident reaches Odoo, Odoo notifies the site manager. The final screen confirms it with «Gerente avisado» (“Manager notified”). The app doesn’t send the alert: Odoo does, once the incident is sent.

### Call from the app

Screens that call for care have call buttons: Llamar al supervisor (Call the supervisor), Llamar a Despacho (Call Dispatch) and Llamar al gerente de sede (Call the site manager). Below each one you see who you are calling and their work phone.

- The app doesn’t place the call itself: it opens the phone’s dialer with the number filled in.

- If nobody answers, when you come back you see Llamar al siguiente: … (Call the next one: …) with the next person on the list.

- People on the current shift come first, day or night. Those on the other shift come after.

- The call is logged with the time: «Llamaste a las …» (“You called at …”).

Message What you do

«No hay teléfono cargado para el supervisor. Búscalo antes de dejar salir.» (“There’s no phone number for the supervisor. Find them before letting anything out.”) Find them in person. Tell the administrator the number is missing.

«Sin señal: no pudimos traer el teléfono del supervisor…» (“No signal: we couldn’t get the supervisor’s phone number…”) Find them in person, or look in Teléfonos (Phones).

«No se pudo abrir el marcador. Marca a mano: …» (“Couldn’t open the dialer. Dial by hand: …”) Dial that number on the phone.

### Phones

In Más › Teléfonos (More › Phones) you’ll find the site’s contacts: supervisors, managers and Dispatch, with their work phones. There are two tabs: Día (Day) and Noche (Night). It opens on the current shift. Tap a contact to call them.

It works without a signal: the phone keeps the last list it received. The “i” shows when it was last updated. If a month goes by without an update, the list is deleted. If there are no contacts: «Sin teléfonos» (“No phones”). Find the supervisor in person.

### «¿Quién autorizó?» (“Who authorized it?”)

When something leaves with a critical difference (a truck) or without a pass (an asset), the app asks who authorized you. What you choose goes into the record with the time.

- Call first. Use the call buttons. The people you called appear at the top of the list, with the time.

- Tap the person who authorized it. Only contacts who can authorize are listed. Dispatch doesn’t authorize.

- If nobody authorized it, tap «Nadie» (Nobody). It’s always at the bottom.

- Sign with your PIN.

The supervisor decides
«La app no retiene el camión: decide el supervisor.» (“The app doesn’t hold the truck: the supervisor decides.”) You call and note what you were told. The decision isn’t your responsibility.


---

## [Receipts and route returns — Zentrix Check documentation](https://zentrix.company/en/check/docs/recepcion.html)

How to receive goods and containers with Zentrix Check: photos, seal check, the supplier invoice, products and signature, plus trucks returning from route.

### Receipts and route returns

Goods that arrive with a supplier invoice are received in steps. A delivery truck coming back is checked without counting.

### Receiving goods

- In Hoy › Llegan (Today › Arriving), tap the arrival. «Llegada» (“Arrival”) opens with the company and the steps. If it is a container, it says «Revisa el precinto primero» (“Check the seal first”).

- Tap «Empezar» (Start). The app fetches the data from Odoo. With no signal, tap Intentar de nuevo (Try again) once you have one.

The steps are: Fotos al llegar · Precinto · Factura del proveedor · Productos · Contenedor vacío · Fotos de lo recibido · Cerrar (Arrival photos · Seal · Supplier invoice · Products · Empty container · Photos of what was received · Close). The seal and empty container steps only appear for containers (the empty container one, only if the site requires it).

### Arrival photos

«Toma una foto del camión entero, con la placa.» (“Take a photo of the whole truck, with the plate.”) If it is a container: «Toma una foto del contenedor cerrado, con su precinto.» (“Take a photo of the closed container, with its seal.”) This comes before the seal step, so the container is shown intact.

### Seal (containers)

- Take a photo of the seal where the number can be read.

- Scan or type its number. «Escríbelo como lo ves. La oficina lo compara con lo declarado.» (“Type it as you see it. The office compares it with what was declared.”)

- Look at the outside of the container before cutting the seal. If the site requires it, the app asks about the doors, the locks and the underside of the container: no holes, no fresh welds and no repairs.

- Check the seal. «¿Está entero?» (“Is it intact?”), «¿Se lee el número?» (“Can you read the number?”), «¿Firme al girar?» (“Firm when twisted?”), «¿Aguanta al halar?» (“Does it hold when pulled?”). Tap Sí (Yes) or No for each one.

- Cut it with the driver watching. The app asks «¿Chofer presente?» (“Is the driver present?”).

If anything fails: «El precinto no pasó la revisión» (“The seal failed the check”). It is critical: «Llama al supervisor: él decide qué se hace con el contenedor.» (“Call the supervisor: they decide what to do with the container.”)

### Supplier invoice

«Tómale foto a la factura del proveedor. Si no la trae, toca No trae.» (“Take a photo of the supplier invoice. If they don’t have it, tap Doesn’t have it.”)

- They have an invoice: take a photo, then scan or type its number.

- They don’t have an invoice: tap No trae (Doesn’t have it) and take a photo of the delivery slip or the carrier’s waybill. If they have no paperwork at all, tap Sin papel (No paperwork). It is logged as a difference and the office resolves it in Odoo.

### Products

Same as for a departure: you scan each product, count cases and loose units, and log anything over or short. [How it works](https://zentrix.company/en/check/docs/salida.html#productos).

### Empty container

«Cuando terminen de descargar, ¿el contenedor ya está vacío?» (“Once unloading is done, is the container empty?”)

- Yes: the app asks about the floor, the walls, the roof and the back wall. If something is wrong, take a photo of the problem.

- No (it isn’t empty yet): «No se revisa por dentro. Queda anotado.» (“The inside isn’t checked. It is noted.”)

### Photos of what was received, and signing

«Toma una foto de lo recibido en el andén.» (“Take a photo of what was received on the loading dock.”) Then review the steps and sign with your PIN, as for a [departure](https://zentrix.company/en/check/docs/salida.html#cerrar). Finally, tap Hoy (Today).

A critical difference on receipt
«Anota la diferencia en la guía del transportista antes de que se vaya, y tómale foto.» (“Write the difference on the carrier’s waybill before they leave, and take a photo of it.”) That photo goes into the record.

If the arrival already has a record, the app tells you: «Esta recepción ya se registró.» (“This receipt has already been logged.”) If Odoo changed it afterwards: «Cambió en Odoo después del acta. Hay que revisarla otra vez.» (“It changed in Odoo after the record. It needs to be checked again.”)

### A truck that isn’t on the list

In Llegan (Arriving), tap Otro camión (Another truck). «Llama al supervisor antes de dejarlo entrar.» (“Call the supervisor before letting it in.”) If it comes in, tap Registrar llegada (Log arrival) and log it as [something coming in without paperwork](https://zentrix.company/en/check/docs/sin-documento.html).

### Route returns

A delivery truck that left with its load comes back to the site. It is checked without counting: you only look at whether it is bringing anything back.

- In Hoy › Llegan (Today › Arriving), tap «Vuelve» (Returning). «¿Cuál camión?» (“Which truck?”) appears: the trucks out on route, with their plate and departure time. If there are many, filter by typing the plate. You can also tap Escanear (Scan) and point at the delivery note.

- Tap the plate and answer «¿Es este camión?» (“Is it this truck?”).

- «¿Es el chofer?» (“Is this the driver?”) Ask for their ID card.

- «¿Trae mercancía?» (“Is it bringing goods back?”) Open the door, look, and tap Sí (Yes) or No.

- Take the photo. If it comes back empty: «Abre las puertas y toma una foto del camión vacío, con la placa.» (“Open the doors and take a photo of the empty truck, with the plate.”) If it brings something: «Antes de bajar nada, toma una foto de lo que vuelve, con las puertas abiertas.» (“Before unloading anything, take a photo of what is coming back, with the doors open.”)

- Sign with your PIN. «Acta firmada. Toca Hoy.» (“Record signed. Tap Today.”)

If you say it is empty and Odoo expects goods, the app asks «¿Seguro vacío?» (“Sure it’s empty?”) with «Odoo espera mercancía» (“Odoo expects goods”). Tap Revisar (Check) to look again, or Sí, vacío (Yes, empty).

If there are no trucks on route, the list says «Nadie en ruta» (“Nobody on route”). If one arrives anyway, tap Otro camión (Another truck).


---

## [Truck departures — Zentrix Check documentation](https://zentrix.company/en/check/docs/salida.html)

How to check a truck leaving the gate with Zentrix Check: plate and driver, delivery note, invoices, products, photos, padlock and your PIN signature.

### Truck departures

Seven steps, from the plate to the signature. You check against what Odoo says and sign with your PIN.

### Opening the truck

- In Hoy › Salen (Today › Leaving), tap the truck. Or tap Escanear (Scan) and point at the delivery note. «Salida» (“Departure”) opens, with the plate and the steps drawn out.

- Answer «¿Lleva otra carga?» (“Is it carrying another load?”). If Odoo has another load for the same plate, the app asks before you start. Tap Sí (Yes) or No. Until every question is answered, there is no Empezar (Start) button.

- Tap «Empezar» (Start). The app fetches the data from Odoo («Trayendo lo de Odoo…» (“Fetching from Odoo…”)) and opens the first step.

Before you start, you can also add another load by hand with Otra carga (Another load), or remove one added by mistake with Quitar (Remove). If Odoo has that load on a different plate, the app asks «¿Va en este camión?» (“Is it going on this truck?”).

What Odoo sends (company, route, loading dock, orders, invoices, products) is under the “i” at the top. The supervisor may ask you for it over the phone.

You need a signal to start
If there is none: «Sin señal: no pudimos traer lo de Odoo para esta carga. Busca señal y toca «Intentar de nuevo».» (“No signal: we couldn’t fetch the Odoo data for this load. Find a signal and tap ‘Try again.’”) Once you have started, you can keep going without a signal.

### The seven steps

The step bar is always at the top. Tap a step to jump to it. The steps are: Camión y chofer · Documentos · Facturas · Productos · Fotos · Candado · Cerrar (Truck and driver · Documents · Invoices · Products · Photos · Padlock · Close).

### 1. Truck and driver

- Take a photo of the plate. Tap Tomar foto (Take photo).

- «¿Es esta placa?» (“Is this the plate?”) Look at the photo and tap Sí (Yes) or No. If No, type the plate you see on the truck (for example, AB123CD).

- «¿Es el chofer?» (“Is this the driver?”) Ask the driver for their ID card and compare it with what Odoo says. If Odoo has no driver, the app says «Odoo sin chofer» (“No driver in Odoo”) and «Avisa a Despacho» (“Tell Dispatch”).

- «¿Todo igual?» (“Everything the same?”) Check the company, the route and the loading dock. If anything is different, tap it and tell Dispatch.

If the plate doesn’t match Odoo, the record shows «La placa no coincide con Odoo» (“The plate doesn’t match Odoo”). It is a critical difference: call the supervisor.

### 2. Documents

- Scan the barcode on the delivery note. If it won’t read, take a photo of it and answer «¿Dice este número?» (“Does it say this number?”).

- If it isn’t the delivery note for this load. Tap Es otra (It’s a different one) and call Dispatch, or Otra vez (Again) to try again.

- If the driver doesn’t have it. Tap No trae (Doesn’t have it). Call Dispatch and carry on.

If the load includes liquor, the app also asks «¿Trae la guía?» (“Do they have the permit?”), meaning the liquor transport permit:

- Yes: type or scan its number and take a photo of it. Then: «¿Placa y chofer?» (“Plate and driver?”), that is, do they match the truck? And «¿Es original?» (“Is it the original?”). A photocopy doesn’t count.

- No: «Licor sin guía de circulación. Llama al supervisor antes de dejar salir y avisa a Despacho.» (“Liquor without a transport permit. Call the supervisor before letting it leave and tell Dispatch.”)

### 3. Invoices

- Tap «Escanear facturas» (Scan invoices) and scan each one. If one won’t read, take a photo of it. The list shows how many are done: «3 de 5 listas» (“3 of 5 done”).

- If the driver has an invoice that isn’t on the list. Tap Factura nueva (New invoice): photo first, then its number.

- If one is missing. Mark it «No viene» (“Not here”). If it turns up later, tap Apareció (Turned up).

If Odoo doesn’t have invoices yet: «Odoo todavía no tiene facturas para esta carga. Fotografía las que trae el chofer.» (“Odoo doesn’t have invoices for this load yet. Photograph the ones the driver has.”)

### 4. Products

Products after «Llenar» (Fill in): filled-in items don’t count as scanned.

There are two ways to do it. You can use both.

- Tap «Llenar» (Fill in). It puts the quantity Odoo says on each product. The app shows «Llenamos 5 con lo de Odoo» (“We filled in 5 from Odoo”) and lets you tap Deshacer (Undo) for a few seconds. Filled-in items are marked «Llenado» (“Filled in”): they don’t count as checked.

- Tap «Escanear» (Scan) and scan each product. The big number only counts what you scanned: «Escaneados 3 de 5» (“3 of 5 scanned”). When you finish: «Todo escaneado» (“All scanned”).

Tap a row to open that product. There you can count cases and loose units and tap Guardar (Save):

- If your count is different from Odoo’s, the app asks «¿Contaste bien?» (“Did you count right?”), showing what Odoo says and what you counted. Tap Sí, son … (Yes, it’s …) or Contar otra vez (Count again).

- If there are none: «¿No está ninguna?» (“None at all?”) → Sí, no está (Yes, it’s not here) or Buscar de nuevo (Look again).

- If it has no barcode: take a photo of it. It is marked «Llenado · con foto» (“Filled in · with photo”).

If you scan something that isn’t part of the load, the app asks whether to log it as surplus (Anotar (Log it) or No anotar (Don’t log it)). If it doesn’t recognize it: «No lo conocemos» (“We don’t recognize it”). If it is going on the truck, tap A mano (By hand) and add it with its photo.

Green is earned by scanning
Filling in is quick, but it isn’t checking. If you sign with products marked «Llenado» (Filled in), the record says «Con salvedad» (“With a caveat”) and how many you signed that way. Scan whatever you can.

### 5. Photos

«Toma una foto de la carga dentro del camión, con las puertas abiertas.» (“Take a photo of the load inside the truck, with the doors open.”) Tap Tomar foto (Take photo). You can take Otra (Another).

### 6. Padlock

«¿Le pusieron candado a las puertas?» (“Are the doors padlocked?”) Tap Sí (Yes) or No.

- Yes: you can take a photo (it’s optional) and tap Siguiente (Next).

- No: the app offers to call Dispatch. It is logged as a remark.

At some sites this step starts with «¿Cabina vacía?» (“Is the cab empty?”): look behind the seats and in the sleeper bunk. The driver’s belongings don’t count. If there are boxes or products, tap No and take a photo with no people in it. «Mercancía en cabina» (“Goods in the cab”) appears: it is a critical difference.

### 7. Close and sign

Revisa y firma (Review and sign): the status of each step before you sign.

- Review the steps. «Revisa y firma» (“Review and sign”) shows one row per step with its status: «Completo» (“Complete”), «Falta» (“Missing”), «Con salvedad» (“With a caveat”), «Con diferencia» (“With a difference”) or «Crítica» (“Critical”). Tap a row to fix it, and you come back here.

- Tap «Firmar» (Sign). A sheet opens with the plate, the records and, if there is one, the caveat: «Firmo lo que revisé. … como «Llenado» (cantidad de Odoo, sin revisarlos uno por uno)» (“I sign what I checked. … as ‘Filled in’ (Odoo quantity, not checked one by one)”).

- Enter your PIN. The sheet says «…, firma con tu PIN» (“…, sign with your PIN”). When it’s done: «Acta firmada» (“Record signed”).

- When the truck goes through the gate, tap «Salió» (Left). The app asks «¿Ya salió?» (“Has it left?”). If it is still at the gate, tap Todavía no (Not yet): the truck stays in Salen (Leaving) as «Lista para salir» (“Ready to leave”) and you tap Salió later.

Next to the record you see ✓ («Acta guardada en el teléfono» (“Record saved on the phone”), it will be sent automatically) or ✓✓ («Acta recibida por Odoo» (“Record received by Odoo”)). A signed record can no longer be edited.

### Differences

Anything that doesn’t match Odoo is logged as a difference. Odoo grades it at three levels:

Level In the app What you do

S1 · critical Red: «Diferencia crítica» (“Critical difference”), «Crítica» (“Critical”) Call the supervisor before letting it leave.

S2 · major «Con diferencia» (“With a difference”) Sign anyway. If the app asks, tell Dispatch.

S3 · minor «Con observación» (“With a remark”) Sign anyway. It stays on record.

Critical differences include: liquor short or over, liquor without a transport permit, a different plate and goods in the cab. When one comes up, the whole screen turns red with the cause («Licor sin guía» (“Liquor without a permit”), «Placa distinta» (“Different plate”), «Faltan productos» (“Products missing”)…) and «Llama al supervisor antes de dejar salir» (“Call the supervisor before letting it leave”). Tap Llamar al supervisor (Call the supervisor) and then Entendido (Got it).

The app doesn’t hold the truck
«La app no retiene el camión: decide el supervisor.» (“The app doesn’t hold the truck: the supervisor decides.”) You call, log it and sign. The difference that counts is the one Odoo calculates, and the office resolves it.

### «¿Quién autorizó?» (“Who authorized it?”)

If the record has a critical difference and you tap Salió (Left), the app asks «¿Quién autorizó?» (“Who authorized it?”).

- Tap the person who authorized you. At the top are the people you called from the app, with the time of the call. Below them, the contacts on the current schedule.

- If nobody authorized it, tap «Nadie» (Nobody). It is always last. The app says: «Nadie autorizó. Llama al supervisor. Si el camión sale igual, toca Salió.» (“Nobody authorized it. Call the supervisor. If the truck leaves anyway, tap Left.”)

- Sign with your PIN. Who authorized it (or that nobody did) is recorded, with the time. Odoo notifies the site manager.

More about the contacts: [Incidents and calls](https://zentrix.company/en/check/docs/novedades.html#quien-autorizo).

### If you get interrupted

You can leave a truck halfway through. It stays at the top of Hoy (Today), on the «Seguir» (Continue) card. If the app closes, what you logged is saved: «La app se cerró. Lo que ya registraste está guardado y se envía solo.» (“The app closed. What you already logged is saved and will be sent automatically.”) Tap Seguir (Continue).


---

## [Movements without paperwork — Zentrix Check documentation](https://zentrix.company/en/check/docs/sin-documento.html)

How to log what comes in or goes out without an Odoo document in Zentrix Check: the reason, the items with photos, the return date and your PIN signature.

### Movements without paperwork

Whatever comes in or goes out without being in Odoo is logged too: what it is, why, how many and whether it comes back.

### Starting an entry

Tap Registrar (Register) at the bottom. Choose a picture:

- Sale (Out): something leaves the site without paperwork.

- Entra (In): something comes in without paperwork.

- De tercero (Third party): an item from another company coming in, such as a technician’s tools.

You can also start from Hoy (Today): scan a product and tap Sale or Entra.

### The reason

The app asks «¿Por qué sale?» (“Why is it going out?”) or «¿Por qué entra?» (“Why is it coming in?”). Tap a reason and Siguiente (Next).

Sale (Out) Entra (In)

Activo · Préstamo · Mantenimiento · Desecho · Devolución · Muestra · Donación · Otro (Asset · Loan · Maintenance · Disposal · Return · Sample · Donation · Other) Activo · Mantenimiento · Muestra · Préstamo · Donación · Otro (Asset · Maintenance · Sample · Loan · Donation · Other)

Activo (Asset) is a tagged piece of company property: it takes you to scan its tag. See [Assets and passes](https://zentrix.company/en/check/docs/activos.html).

For De tercero (Third party), the question is «¿De qué empresa?» (“Which company?”). Type only the company. If there isn’t one, tap Siguiente (Next).

### The items

- Tap «Escanear» (Scan) and scan each item. If it is in the catalog, the name fills in automatically.

- If it has no barcode, tap «A mano» (By hand). First the photo (it is required). Then «¿Qué es?» (“What is it?”): type it or dictate it with the keyboard microphone. Last, «¿Cuántos?» (“How many?”): choose Unidad, Caja, Bulto, Kg or Otro (Unit, Case, Package, Kg or Other) and the quantity.

- Tap a row to change the quantity with − and +, or to Quitar (Remove) it.

Don’t write names or ID numbers
In the description and the company field, write only what the item is and which company it belongs to. Never personal data.

Message What it means

«No conocemos este código. Agrégalo a mano.» (“We don’t recognize this code. Add it by hand.”) Add it with A mano (By hand), with its photo.

«Escribiste el código. Agrégalo con su foto.» (“You typed the code. Add it with its photo.”) A typed code doesn’t count as scanned: it needs a photo.

«Este artículo es un producto del inventario. Avisamos al administrador.» (“This item is an inventory product. We’ve notified the administrator.”) An Odoo product leaving without paperwork. It is logged as a difference.

Liquor going out without paperwork Critical difference: «Llama al supervisor antes de dejar salir y avisa a Despacho.» (“Call the supervisor before letting it leave and tell Dispatch.”)

### Return and signature

- Tap «Firmar» (Sign). If it hasn’t been answered yet, the app first asks «¿Regresa?» (“Is it coming back?”) for things going out, or «¿Se lo llevan?» (“Are they taking it back?”) for things coming in.

- If Yes, choose the day. «¿Cuándo?» (“When?”): Hoy (Today), Mañana (Tomorrow), Una semana (One week) or Otro día (Another day), and by what time. If the time has already passed, the app says «Esa hora ya pasó. Elige otra.» (“That time has passed. Choose another.”)

- Enter your PIN. The sheet says «Firma este registro» (“Sign this entry”). When it’s done: «Acta firmada» (“Record signed”). Tap Hoy.

Anything that has to come back is listed in Hoy › Adentro (Today › Inside): what went out under «Afuera» (“Out”), and what came in under «Entró y aún no sale» (“Came in and hasn’t left yet”).

### If you leave it halfway

If you leave without signing: «Guardamos este registro. Lo sigues desde Registrar.» (“We saved this entry. Continue it from Register.”) In Registrar (Register), at the top, you see «Registro sin terminar» (“Unfinished entry”) with Seguir (Continue) and Descartar (Discard). If you discard it by mistake, tap Deshacer (Undo).

### When it leaves or comes back

- In Hoy › Adentro (Today › Inside), tap the item that is leaving or coming back.

- Tap «Salió» (Left) or «Volvió» (Returned).

- Answer «¿Igual que entró?» (“Same as when it came in?”) or «¿Igual que salió?» (“Same as when it left?”). If No, type «¿Qué cambió?» (“What changed?”) in a few words, with no names or ID numbers.

- Sign with your PIN. «Salida registrada.» (“Departure logged.”) or «Regreso registrado.» (“Return logged.”)

If the time has passed, the row says «Debía volver …» (“Was due back …”).


---

## [Working without a signal — Zentrix Check documentation](https://zentrix.company/en/check/docs/sin-senal.html)

How Zentrix Check works without a signal at the gate: what ✓ and ✓✓ mean, the queue of entries waiting to be sent, and which tasks still need a connection.

### Working without a signal

At the gate, the signal comes and goes. What you sign is stored on the phone and sent automatically when the signal returns.

### How to tell if there’s a signal

At the top of the screen, the status bar tells you:

- «Sin señal · tu trabajo se guarda en el teléfono.» (“No signal · your work is saved on the phone.”)

- «3 por enviar» (“3 to send”): entries are waiting.

- «Al día» (“Up to date”): everything reached Odoo.

- «Necesita atención» (“Needs attention”): Odoo rejected something. Check it in Por enviar (Waiting to send).

### ✓ and ✓✓

Mark Meaning

✓ «Guardado ✓» (“Saved ✓”): it’s on the phone, signed. It’s sent automatically.

✓✓ «En Odoo ✓✓» (“In Odoo ✓✓”): Odoo has received it.

You see them next to the on-duty switch, on every signed record and in Por enviar (Waiting to send). With ✓ you can move on: what you signed isn’t lost even if the phone turns off.

### Waiting to send

Tap Más › Por enviar (More › Waiting to send).

- At the top: how many are still waiting, or «Al día» (“Up to date”) if nothing is left.

- Below: one row per truck, paperwork-free entry, incident, key or asset, with its ✓ or ✓✓. Tap a row to see each entry.

- Photos go separately: «fotos esperando para subir» (“photos waiting to upload”). They are heavier and upload later.

The queue sends itself. If something got stuck, you see Enviar ahora (Send now). Otherwise, the only button is Hoy (Today).

Nothing is deleted from here. Not when you go off duty, not when you sign out of the phone, and not if the phone is blocked.

### If Odoo doesn’t accept something

The row says «Odoo no aceptó este registro.» (“Odoo didn’t accept this entry.”) (or «Odoo no aceptó esta foto.», “Odoo didn’t accept this photo.”) and, below it, Odoo’s message exactly as sent. Read it: it says what happened. Tap Llamar al supervisor (Call the supervisor) if you don’t know what to do. You don’t sign it again.

### A coworker’s entries

If a coworker signed on this phone and their session expired, their entries wait. The “i” says «Esperando a …» (“Waiting for …”) and «Se enviarán cuando vuelva a entrar aquí.» (“They’ll be sent when they sign in here again.”) Ask them to sign in with their name and PIN.

### What needs a signal

Works without a signal Needs a signal

Signing in with your name and PIN Setting up the phone with the QR code

Going on and off duty Signing in with your password (first time, «Olvidé mi PIN» (“I forgot my PIN”), expired session)

Continuing a truck you already started, and signing it Starting a truck, a receipt or a return («Trayendo lo de Odoo…», “Getting the data from Odoo…”)

Taking photos Refreshing the Hoy (Today) list

Paperwork-free entries and incidents Odoo’s replies (for example, «Gerente avisado», “Manager notified”)

Viewing Teléfonos (Phones), the last saved list The administrator console

Without a signal, Hoy shows the last list that arrived, with «Datos de las …» (“Data from …”). Anything that happened later in Odoo won’t show until the signal returns.

Put simply
What you start with a signal, you can finish without one. What you sign gets there on its own. If you see ✓, it’s safe.


---

## [Zentrix Check — Security gate and access control app](https://zentrix.company/en/check/)

Zentrix Check, the Android app for the security gate: guards check every truck against Odoo®, take photos and sign a record that cannot be changed.

For the security gate · Android

### The gate vouches for what comes in and goes out.

The guard checks every truck against what Odoo® says, takes the photos and signs with a PIN. The result is a record nobody can change, even when the gate has no signal.

App ID: com.leiros.check
How it works

How it works

### How a truck leaves with Zentrix Check.

The app doesn’t ask what the truck carries: it brings that from the company’s system and asks the guard to confirm it with their own eyes. Security vouches; it doesn’t move inventory or touch the books.

Every step is stored with its time, its photo and the name of the person who did it.

- You go on duty at the gate You sign in with your name and your PIN. The “Today” screen shows what is leaving, what is arriving and what is still inside.

- You confirm the truck and the driver You photograph the plate and compare the driver’s ID with what Odoo says. If they don’t match, it is noted.

- Delivery note and invoices You scan the delivery note and each invoice. If the load carries liquor, its transport permit too.

- You count the load Scan product by product, or fill it in from Odoo, which doesn’t count as checked. Every difference gets a severity, and if it is critical the app asks you to call the supervisor.

- Photo of the load and padlock A photo with the doors open and, before closing, the padlock. At some sites, the cab too.

- You sign and tap “Left” With your PIN. The record is closed, with the fingerprint of every photo.

What it helps you do

### Everything that goes through the gate, on record.

Built for the pace of a gate: trucks waiting, paperwork in hand and, often, no signal.

- 01

### Outbound trucks
Plate and driver, delivery note and invoices, the load against Odoo, the photo of the load, the padlock and the signature. Whatever doesn’t match is written down, with its severity.

- 02

### Receipts and returns
Incoming goods, against what was expected and the supplier’s invoice; containers, with a check of their seal. Trucks coming back from their route are reconciled automatically.

- 03

### Movements without paperwork
If something comes in or goes out with no document in the system, it is recorded anyway: what, when and which guard logged it.

- 04

### Keys and assets
The QR key ring shows who took each key and when it came back. Company equipment leaves and returns with a pass the manager approves.

- 05

### Incidents and decisions
An incident in a few words, with a photo if needed. And when a decision has to be made on site, “Who authorized it?” notes who was called and when.

- 06

### Works without a signal
What the guard does is stored encrypted on the phone and sent automatically when the connection returns, in order and without duplicates.

Use cases

### One gate, three moments of the day.

This is how each one looks from the guard’s phone.

- 01

### A loaded truck leaving
The load is already in the system. The guard confirms it, counts, photographs, checks the padlock and signs. If something is missing, the app says how much and of what, and if it is serious it asks to call the supervisor before letting the truck go.

- 02

### A supplier delivering
The guard opens the arrival, checks the seal if it is a container, compares what arrives with what was expected and photographs the supplier’s invoice. The difference is written down before the goods come in.

- 03

### Something leaving without paperwork
A tool, a box, some material. There is no document, but there is a record: what left, when and which guard logged it.

Screen by screen

### This is the gate on the phone.

Big buttons, pictures and short sentences, to work standing up and in a hurry.

Today: what leaves, arrives and stays inside.

You compare the driver with what Odoo says.

You count the load, or fill it in and check it.

You review every step before signing.

An incident, in one tap.

The administrator only looks.

Real screenshots of the app, with a test site and test data. The app is in Spanish.

Security and privacy

### A record that cannot be changed.

What the guard signs is the version that counts. That is why the app is built so nobody can rewrite it later, not even from the office.

- A fingerprint on every photo and every step. Each event carries the fingerprint of the previous one: if someone changes one, it shows. A correction is added as a note; the original stays.

- The phone is a key. It is set up with a QR code and sealed to one site. If it is lost, it is revoked and wipes what it stored.

- Camera only. No location, no gallery and no contacts. Screenshots are blocked on the PIN, password and photo viewer screens.

- Encrypted on the phone. Whatever is waiting to be sent is encrypted, and the PIN never leaves the phone.

- The administrator only looks. They see the day, the records, the differences and the photos of their site, but cannot change what the guard signed.

- No advertising and no advertising ID.

[What data the app records and why](https://zentrix.company/en/check/privacy/)

### Who it is for

For the security staff of companies that use Zentrix Check, on the gate’s Android phone. There is no sign-up: the security administrator creates each guard’s account and sets up each phone. Anyone can install the app, but without that setup it does nothing.

### Getting started

- The security administrator generates the QR code for the gate phone.

- Install Zentrix Check on that phone and scan the code.

- Sign in with your username and password. Only the first time.

- Create your PIN; from then on you sign in with your name and your PIN.

### Zentrix Check, for Android

It is installed from Google Play on the gate phone. Questions? Write to [soporte@zentrix.company](mailto:soporte@zentrix.company?subject=Support%20%E2%80%94%20Zentrix%20Check).

App ID: com.leiros.check
[Support](https://zentrix.company/en/support/#check)

## [Privacy policy — Zentrix Check](https://zentrix.company/en/check/privacy/)

What the Zentrix Check gate app records, why, who sees it and how it is protected, and how to ask for access to your data, its correction or its deletion.

Legal

### Zentrix Check privacy policy

Last updated: October 16, 2026.

### 1. What Zentrix Check is and who it is for

Zentrix Check is the internal work tool of the security staff of the company that uses it (the “company”), at the gate of each site. It is developed and distributed by GUUAO LLC through Google Play, for Android only. Guards use it to record what comes in and goes out: loaded trucks leaving, goods arriving, keys, company equipment and incidents. The app does not move inventory or touch the accounting: it only records what the guard checked.

It is not a consumer app and it does not allow sign-up. Each guard’s account is created by the company’s security administrator, and each phone is set up with a QR code that seals it to one site. Without that, the app does nothing.

This policy applies to these people:

- The guard: the company employee who uses the app with their account.

- The security administrator: who reviews the day, the records and the photos of their site from the app. They can only look; they cannot change what the guard signed.

- People whose data goes through the gate even if they don’t use the app: drivers and carriers, those named on the invoices and papers that travel with a load, employees who take a key or a piece of equipment, and the site contacts the guard may call.

The processing is part of the employment relationship and of access control to the company’s premises. The app does not show a consent dialog: recording who checked what, and when, is the very purpose of the tool. The only permission the phone asks for is the camera, and it is Android that asks.

### 2. What data is collected and why

### About the guard and the administrator

Data What it is used for

Name and username Identifying the guard on the gate phone and on every record they sign. The username is that of their account in the company’s system.

Password Signing in the first time on each phone. It is validated by the company’s server; the app does not store it. What is stored is the session, encrypted on the phone.

PIN Signing in afterwards with name and PIN, and signing every record. It is a local lock: it is stored hashed on the phone and never leaves it.

Administrator’s two-factor code The security administrator also signs in with a one-time code, validated by the company’s server.

Going on and off duty When the guard went on and off duty at the gate, the time of their last action, the site and the post. It shows who was in charge. It is not a working-time record.

Log of what they do Every step of every record, with its time and the guard who did it: departures, receipts, counts, differences, signatures, keys, incidents and decisions. It is the gate’s audit trail.

Phone and session data Phone model, Android and app version, and an installation identifier generated by the app. The company’s server also logs the IP address and dates of each session. They show which phone did what, allow cutting off a lost phone and enforcing a minimum app version.

Phone and app integrity When the phone is set up and at sign-in, the app asks Google Play to confirm that the app is genuine and runs on an unaltered phone. See clause 6.

Usage and crash data Which screens are used, without any record data, and technical reports when the app fails. Details in clause 6.

### About people whose data goes through the gate

Data What it is used for

Vehicle plate and photo of the plate Confirming that the vehicle leaving or arriving is the one the system expects. The plate comes from the company’s dispatch; the guard only types it if it doesn’t match or is missing.

Driver’s name and the last 4 digits of their ID Confirming that the driver is the assigned one. They come from the company’s system; the app never shows the full ID number and keeps it on the phone for 12 hours at most.

Photos of the load, cab, container and seals Recording the condition of the load and the vehicle on departure or arrival. They are photos of things: the app asks that no people appear.

Photos of invoices and carrier papers Recording the documents that travel with the load. They may show the name, tax ID or ID number, address and amounts of customers, suppliers and drivers. They are stored with the same restricted access as the records.

Who takes a key or a piece of equipment The employee, picked from the company’s list, and the time out and back. Never their ID number. If the person is not on the list, their name is not written down.

Text and photos of an incident Two or three words about what happened and, if needed, up to three photos of things. The app asks not to write names or ID numbers and masks any run of six digits.

Site contacts and logged calls The role, schedule and work phone of the people the guard may call (supervisor, manager, dispatch). When the guard calls from the app, who and when is noted; the call is not recorded and its duration is not stored.

### 3. What the app does NOT do

- It does not use location. The app doesn’t even ask for that permission.

- It does not read the phone’s gallery, contacts, messages or files. Photos are taken with the camera from within the app.

- It does not record audio. The app may read prompts aloud with the voices already installed on the phone, without downloading anything. If the guard dictates with the keyboard’s microphone, that dictation is handled by the phone’s keyboard, not by Zentrix Check.

- It does not use facial recognition or biometric data, and it does not ask for photos of people or identity documents.

- It does not send push notifications.

- It does not sell data, show ads or build marketing profiles.

- It does not use the phone’s advertising ID.

- It does not send the PIN anywhere.

- It does not send screenshots, record contents or photos in crash reports or usage metrics.

- It does not copy its data to the phone’s cloud backup or to a new phone.

- It does not allow changing a signed record. A correction is added as a note and the original is kept.

### 4. Where it is stored

The data is stored on the company’s servers, in its management system (Odoo), together with the rest of the information about each load. The app talks to them over HTTPS only.

The gate phone keeps the phone key, the session and each guard’s PIN in Android’s secure storage (Keystore); whatever has not been sent yet, encrypted; and photos and drafts of unfinished work in the app’s private storage, until they are sent or expire. If the phone is revoked, the app wipes all of that as soon as it reconnects. Uninstalling the app also makes Android delete it.

### 5. How long it is kept

We keep access records, evidence photos and the event log for as long as they are needed for the security of the premises and to meet legal obligations; after that they are deleted or anonymized.

- Driver data on the phone: the gate phone keeps it for 12 hours at most.

- Crash reports: according to the period set at the provider, which does not exceed 90 days.

- Usage metrics: according to the period set in Google Analytics, which does not exceed 14 months.

- PIN and session: live only on the phone and are deleted when leaving the phone, revoking it or uninstalling the app.

When a photo or a piece of data is deleted, the log row may remain, with its fingerprint and the deletion date, so the chain of records stays verifiable. Whatever an authority asks to keep for an open case is kept until the case ends.

### 6. Who it is shared with

Within the company, access is limited to those who need it for their role and to their site: the guard sees their gate; the security administrator, the head of security and the site manager see the records, differences and photos of their site; and whoever sees the load in the system sees the copy of its invoices. When something needs attention, the system creates a task for the manager, which may reach them by email depending on their preferences.

To work, the app uses these providers. They process data on behalf of the company and not for their own purposes:

- Google LLC — Google Analytics for Firebase: measures which screens are used, identified by a generic name and without numbers or record data. It receives an app installation identifier and technical data about the phone. It does not receive names, plates, seals, scanned codes or photos.

- Google LLC — Play Integrity API: when the phone is set up and at sign-in, it checks that the app is genuine and the phone is unaltered. It receives technical information about the phone and the app.

- Functional Software, Inc. (Sentry), United States: receives technical reports when the app fails: the error, the app and Android version, the phone model and the server it was connected to. They never include the guard’s name or username, screenshots, record contents, photos or scanned codes.

Some of these providers process data outside Venezuela, mainly in the United States.

Beyond that, data is only handed to third parties when a competent authority requires it under the law.

The website. This policy is about the app. The zentrix.company website, where you are probably reading it, shows no ads and only measures visits with Google Analytics if the person accepts it in the cookie notice; without that permission it sets no cookies and loads nothing from Google. What is measured and how to withdraw permission is in [Cookies and analytics](https://zentrix.company/en/privacy/#cookies). Like any website, it is served by a hosting provider (GitHub, with Cloudflare in front), which sees the connection’s IP address in order to deliver the page.

### 7. Access, correction and deletion

Anyone whose data goes through Zentrix Check, guard or not, can ask to see, correct or delete their data. To do so, write to [soporte@zentrix.company](mailto:soporte@zentrix.company?subject=Data%20request%20%E2%80%94%20Zentrix%20Check) with the subject Data request — Zentrix Check and the details needed to identify you. Guards can also ask the security administrator.

Deleting the account. The app does not allow creating accounts, so they are not deleted from it either: the company creates and closes them. When a guard asks to close their account, or leaves the company, their access is removed and their personal data that does not need to be kept is deleted. The records they signed are kept, because they are the log of what came in and went out of the company; a mistake in them is corrected with a note, not by rewriting them.

We reply within 30 business days at most. If something cannot be deleted because of a legal, accounting or tax obligation, or an ongoing claim or investigation, we tell you why and for how long.

Leaving the phone, forgetting the PIN or uninstalling the app does not delete anything from the server. It only removes the session from the phone. To delete data, use the channel above.

### 8. Minors

Zentrix Check is a work tool for adults (18 or older) who work in the company’s security. It is not aimed at minors and does not knowingly collect data from minors. The app instructs guards never to photograph minors.

### 9. Security

- All communication with the company’s servers is encrypted (HTTPS/TLS).

- Each phone is sealed to one site with its own key; the server stores only its fingerprint, not the key.

- The session, the phone key and the PIN are stored in Android’s secure storage (Keystore). The PIN is stored hashed and never leaves the phone.

- Whatever is waiting to be sent is stored encrypted (AES-256) on the phone.

- Each event carries the fingerprint of the previous one and each photo its SHA-256 fingerprint: if someone alters a record or a photo, it shows.

- Screenshots are blocked on the PIN, password and photo viewer screens.

- On every operation, the server checks who the guard is, from which phone and at which site. What the phone says is not enough.

- Access for a guard or a phone can be withdrawn at any time. When a phone is revoked, the app wipes what it stored.

No security measure is absolute, and we keep working to improve them.

### 10. Changes to this policy

If the data the app handles changes, this page will be updated and the date at the top will change. Important changes will also be announced to security staff through the company’s internal channels.

### 11. Contact

GUUAO LLC [soporte@zentrix.company](mailto:soporte@zentrix.company)

## [Terms of use — Zentrix Check](https://zentrix.company/en/check/terms/)

The terms of use of the Zentrix Check app for security guards: what it is for, what you agree to when using it, the records it keeps and who provides it.

Legal

### Zentrix Check terms of use

Last updated: October 16, 2026.

### 1. What it is and who provides it

Zentrix Check is the internal work tool for the security staff of the company that uses it (“the company” from here on), provided by GUUAO LLC. By using it, you accept these terms. Your employment relationship is governed by your contract with the company and by labor law; these terms only cover the use of the app.

### 2. Who may use it

Only adults who have been given a guard or security administrator account by the company. The app does not allow sign-ups. Each phone is set up with a QR code that seals it to one site, and the server checks on every operation who you are, from which phone and at which site.

### 3. Your account, password and PIN

Your account is personal and non-transferable. Your PIN is your signature: every record you close is signed in your name. Don’t share your password or PIN, don’t let anyone else work with your profile, and leave the phone when you finish. If you think someone used your account, or the gate phone is lost, tell the security administrator right away or write to [soporte@zentrix.company](mailto:soporte@zentrix.company).

### 4. Permitted use

- Use the app only for the company’s gate control: departures, receipts, movements, keys, assets and incidents.

- Record what you actually see. Confirming a count, a plate or a seal without checking it is a serious breach.

- Photograph things, not people. Never photograph minors. Don’t write names or ID numbers in incidents.

- What you see in the app (plates, drivers, invoices, loads and photos) is confidential. Don’t copy it, screenshot it, share it or use it outside your work at the gate.

- Don’t try to bypass the app’s or the server’s controls, or use the app at a site or on a phone that isn’t yours to use.

### 5. Records are not changed

A signed record is final: neither you, nor the administrator, nor anyone in the office can rewrite it. If you made a mistake, the correction is added as a note with its reason, and the original is kept. The app does not validate inventory or accounting: it records what you checked, and the company makes the decisions about the goods.

### 6. The server decides

The app shows what the company’s system decides. If the server rejects an operation, the app shows you the reason as it arrives and does not work around it. Without a signal, what you do is stored on the phone and sent automatically later; the server receives it in order and verifies it.

### 7. The gate phone

The app is designed for the gate’s Android phone, which the company sets up at a site. The only permission it asks for is the camera; without it you cannot take the record photos. The company can revoke a phone at any time, and the app then wipes what it had stored.

### 8. Availability and versions

We do our best to keep the app available, but there may be outages, failures or maintenance. The company may require a minimum version: if your version is blocked, the app tells you and it has to be updated from Google Play to continue.

### 9. Suspension and end of access

The company may suspend or close your access when your employment or your assignment to the site ends, if you breach these terms, or to protect the security of the premises and the data. What happens to your data afterwards is in the [privacy policy](https://zentrix.company/en/check/privacy/).

### 10. Intellectual property

The app, its design and its brand belong to GUUAO LLC. We give you permission to use them only while you work with the app and for what is described here.

### 11. Privacy

What data the app records and why is in the [privacy policy](https://zentrix.company/en/check/privacy/), which is part of these terms.

### 12. Liability

The app is offered as a work tool, as is. To the extent permitted by law, GUUAO LLC is not liable for indirect damages arising from failures of the app, the phone or the network. Nothing here limits the rights labor law gives you.

### 13. Changes

We may update these terms. The version in force is the one published on this page, with its date at the top. Important changes will be announced through the company’s internal channels.

### 14. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela. We will first try to settle any disagreement amicably, by writing to [soporte@zentrix.company](mailto:soporte@zentrix.company). If there is no agreement within 30 calendar days, the dispute will go to the competent courts of Venezuela. Disputes arising from the employment relationship are governed by labor law.

Our products

### Two apps for everyday work.

One for the team serving customers in the store, and one for the people selling in the field. Both are in production, real teams use them every day, and they connect to your management system.

### The problem it solves

In a busy store, orders get lost in a flood of messages, nobody knows who's handling what, and personal phones keep ringing even after hours. Zentrix Work brings order to that work: every order reaches a specific person at the right moment, and there's a record of who did what.

### Who it's for

For store teams who prepare orders, make deliveries, and take returns, and for managers who need to see the shift in real time. It runs on Android, on each person's own phone.

### What you get

- Work comes to you: the order rings in your pocket and you take it with a swipe.
- Prepare orders without mistakes: scan each product with the camera.
- Your phone gets a break: off shift, you don't get a single notification.
- Managers see everything: who's on shift, what they're handling, and how long it takes.

[Learn more about Zentrix Work](https://zentrix.company/en/work/)

### The problem it solves

Sales reps spend the day in the field, often with no signal, and orders arrive late, on paper or by text message. The office doesn't know what was sold or collected until the end of the day. Zentrix Sales sends each sale straight to your system, online or offline.

### Who it's for

For distributors and field sales teams who visit customers, take orders, and collect on invoices, and for supervisors who need to follow the route. It runs on Android and iPhone.

### What you get

- Sell even with no signal: the order is saved and goes out on its own once you're back online.
- Every visit is recorded: arrival, photos, signature, and wrap-up, step by step.
- Collect against open invoices, with the day's exchange rate and a receipt.
- Your ERP has the final say: prices and taxes are recalculated when the order arrives.

[Learn more about Zentrix Sales](https://zentrix.company/en/sales/)

## [Zentrix Logistics — Logistics and delivery software](https://zentrix.company/en/logistics/)

Logistics and delivery software on Odoo®: picking, dispatch and last-mile delivery, live delivery fleet management, cash on delivery and returns.

Zentrix Logistics · Logistics and delivery

### From the warehouse to the door, without losing track.

Replenishment, picking, dispatch, delivery, cash on delivery and returns on top of your Odoo®, with your team working from Zentrix Work. It already moves GUUAO’s and Grupo Leiros’s orders every day.

[Let’s talk](https://zentrix.company/en/contact/) See the journey

The problem it solves

### Between the warehouse and the door, things get lost.

The order leaves the system, but the parcels, the dispatch note, who carries it, what was collected and what came back end up in spreadsheets, paper and chat groups. When the customer asks, nobody can answer for sure.
Zentrix Logistics keeps everything in a single Odoo record and asks every step for its proof: the scan, the label, the pickup code, the photo and the receipt.

### Who it is for

For retail, distribution and consumer goods companies that pick, dispatch and deliver every day, with Odoo® as their inventory system. If you don’t have it yet, Zentrix Software implements it.

How it works

### Seven steps, one record.

Every step writes to Odoo as it happens and hands the next task to whoever has to do it.

- 01

### Replenish
Odoo’s replenishment rules, kept up to date without slowing down sales.

- 02

### Pick
The order rings on the phone, every item is scanned and every parcel gets its rack slot.

- 03

### Pack
A picking ticket and a label per parcel, printed on their own at the store station.

- 04

### Dispatch
A dispatch batch with driver, vehicle and dock, and a dispatch note that follows the invoice.

- 05

### Deliver
With your own fleet or an external courier. Drivers order their stops and navigate by voice.

- 06

### Collect
At the door, in cash or by card terminal, with a photo of the receipt and its reference.

- 07

### Return
What wasn’t delivered comes back with a reason, and authorized returns are received in store.

Modules

### Everything that happens between the shelf and the customer.

Every module says whether it is in production or in development. We don’t sell what doesn’t exist yet.

- [Delivery with your own fleet or a third party Your drivers work from Zentrix Work, and the external courier (ARMI today) is quoted by load, dispatched and tracked by webhook, all in the same flow. In production How drivers deliver](https://zentrix.company/en/work/docs/)

### Replenishment
Replenishment with Odoo’s rules, fast even with thousands of products, and stock that can’t go negative. Suggested minimums and maximums are on the way.
In productionIn developmentWhat’s ready
- [Picking and packing Camera scanner, shortages with a suggested substitute, parcels on the rack, a label per parcel and FEFO at the point of sale: the lot that expires first leaves first. In production How picking works](https://zentrix.company/en/work/docs/)

### Dispatch and dispatch notes
Dispatch batches with driver, vehicle and dock. No parcel leaves until its label is scanned, and the dispatch note reaches the invoice. Automatic route notes are in development.
In productionIn developmentWhat’s ready

### Live tracking and control room
Orders per store, the fleet map and incidents in one console. From there you can warn a customer about a delay or pause a store.
In productionWhat’s ready
- [Cash on delivery Every payment has an owner and a clock: declared at the door, reconciled when the trip closes, and anyone holding cash for over 24 hours can’t start a shift without approval. In production How drivers collect](https://zentrix.company/en/work/docs/)
- [Returns Stores receive only what Support authorized, with a mandatory photo. On the road, “Couldn’t deliver” records the reason and the order comes back. In production How returns work](https://zentrix.company/en/work/docs/)

Integration

### Three layers that work as one.

Zentrix Logistics isn’t another system to sync. It lives on top of your Odoo inventory and gives your people in store and on the road an app built for their job.

- The people

### Zentrix Work
Pickers, counter staff, drivers and whoever receives returns work from their phone, with shifts, alerts that ring, a scanner and proof of delivery.
[Learn more Zentrix Work](https://zentrix.company/en/work/)

- The rules and the road

### Zentrix Logistics
Builds loads and dispatch notes, connects to couriers, asks for proof at every step and gives the control room a view of the street.

- The inventory

### Odoo®
Products, lots and expiry dates, warehouses, replenishment, transfers, invoices and payments. The single source of truth.
[Learn more Odoo®](https://zentrix.company/en/software/)

Industries

### Built for companies that move product every day.

### Retail and home delivery
Stores that pick online orders and hand them over at the counter or at the door.
- Guided picking with a scanner and parcels on the rack.
- In-store pickup with a code, and age checks for orders with liquor.
- Delivery with your drivers or an external courier.

### Wholesale distribution
Dispatch by batches and routes, with drivers, vehicles and invoices handed to the customer.
- Dispatch batches with driver, vehicle and dock.
- Dispatch notes that follow the invoice and the order.
- Credit terms counted from delivery, not from the invoice.

### Consumer goods
Products with lots and expiry dates, high turnover and cash collected on the road.
- FEFO: the lot that expires first leaves first.
- No negative stock and no made-up lots.
- Cash on delivery with custody and reconciliation.

Real cases

### In production, every day.

Zentrix Logistics comes from two real operations that share the same Odoo®.

G

### GUUAO
Retail and home delivery · Venezuela
Orders from the app ring on the store team’s phones, get picked with the scanner, leave with a label on every parcel and reach the door with in-house drivers or an external courier. The control room watches the street live and every cash-on-delivery payment is reconciled.
- [Zentrix Work](https://zentrix.company/en/work/)
- [Zentrix Work documentation](https://zentrix.company/en/work/docs/)
GL

### Grupo Leiros
Beverage distribution · Venezuela
It dispatches in batches with driver, vehicle and dock. The dispatch note follows the invoice, credit days are counted from delivery, and pickups requested by field reps are scheduled with a driver and a vehicle.
- [Zentrix Sales](https://zentrix.company/en/sales/)
- [Customers](https://zentrix.company/en/customers/)

Transparency

### What’s in production and what’s in development.

We’d rather be clear from the start.

### In production In production today
- Guided picking with a scanner, parcels on the rack, a ticket and a label per parcel, and print agents in each store.
- FEFO and lot control at the point of sale. No negative stock.
- Replenishment with Odoo’s rules, without slowing down sales.
- Dispatch batches, dispatch notes through to the invoice, invoice hand-over and pickups scheduled with driver and vehicle.
- Delivery with in-house drivers on Zentrix Work and an external courier (ARMI, prepaid).
- Control room: orders per store, fleet map, incidents, delay alerts and store pausing.
- Cash on delivery with custody, reconciliation and trip closing.
- Authorized returns received in store.

### In development In development
- Suggested minimums and maximums, forecasts and purchase arrival dates.
- Planned cycle counts, so no product goes more than 90 days uncounted.
- Proposed lot swaps, applied only with approval.
- Route dispatch notes generated as drafts.
- Automatic pricing for your own fleet and vehicle choice by weight.
- Cash on delivery through the external courier.

### What it doesn’t do
It doesn’t optimize routes on its own: drivers order their stops. And, for now, there is no tracking page for the end customer.

### Let’s talk about your operation.

Tell us how you dispatch and deliver today, and we’ll show you how it would look with Zentrix Logistics on your Odoo®.

[Let’s talk](https://zentrix.company/en/contact/) [Message us on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/584123469712)

## [Website privacy — Zentrix](https://zentrix.company/en/privacy/)

What zentrix.company measures and with which tool, with no advertising, and how to withdraw cookie consent. The apps have their own privacy policies.

Zentrix

### Website privacy

This page is about the zentrix.company website. The apps have their own policies: [Zentrix Work](https://zentrix.company/en/work/privacy/), [Zentrix Sales](https://zentrix.company/en/sales/privacy/) and [Zentrix Check](https://zentrix.company/en/check/privacy/). This is a courtesy translation; the binding version is the [Spanish one](https://zentrix.company/privacidad/).

### Cookies and analytics

What we measure. If you accept, the site counts visits to learn which pages help and which do not: the page you open (without the address parameters, except utm_ campaign ones), the product or section, the language, language changes and clicks on contact, email, WhatsApp, app store and Traza links (only the destination). We do not measure what you type in forms, nor your name, email or phone.

With what. With Google Analytics (GA4), from Google LLC, in the analytics account of GUUAO LLC, the entity that publishes the Zentrix apps; the receiving servers are in the United States. Google Analytics also receives technical data about the browser and device and an approximate location (country or city); it does not store the IP address. The cookies are _ga and _ga_H0HG8XPTES, last up to two years, and the data is kept for the period set in Google Analytics, which does not exceed 14 months.

No advertising. The site shows no ads and does not use the data for advertising: ad storage and ad data (ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization) are always denied and Google Signals is off.

If you do not accept. Until you press «Accept», the site loads nothing from Google and sets no cookies. If you reject, or if your browser sends «Do Not Track» or «Global Privacy Control», nothing is measured. Your choice is kept in the browser's local storage (zx-consent); it never leaves it and it is not a cookie.

How to withdraw consent. Press «Cookie preferences», at the foot of any page, and choose «Reject»: measurement stops and the site's _ga cookies are deleted. You can also clear the site's data from your browser. For any question, write to [hola@zentrix.company](mailto:hola@zentrix.company).

## [Your orders and activity — Zentrix Sales documentation](https://zentrix.company/en/sales/docs/actividad.html)

The Activity tab in Zentrix Sales: your drafts under Open, what each order status means, what you can do with an order, and your visits and returns.

Documentation for version 5.3.0

### Your orders and activity

The «Actividad» (Activity) tab in the bottom bar keeps everything you’ve done: Pedidos (Orders), Visitas (Visits) and Devoluciones (Returns).

### How the screen works

Activity › Orders › «Abiertos» (Open). This is where the half-built visits are.

At the top are the three sub-tabs. Below them, all three have the same things:

- A search box: type the customer, the RIF (tax ID) or the number.

- Chips with counts: each one says how many there are and, when you tap it, shows only those. The first is «Todos» (All) and brings everything back.

- The «Filtros y orden» (Filters and sort) button, to the right of the search box, to filter by customer or date, or change the order.

In «Pedidos» (Orders), the button in the corner creates a new order.

### «Abiertos» are your drafts

The «Abiertos» (Open) chip groups the orders you started and didn’t finish. The card tells you since when and which step you stopped at: «Lo empezaste hace 6 días · quedó en Pedido» (“You started it 6 days ago · stopped at Order”).

Tap it and you pick up where you left off, with everything you had entered. Nothing is lost. The trash can button discards it if you no longer want it.

### Order statuses

Every order has a status. Here’s what’s happening with each one:

It says What’s happening What you do

En tu teléfono (On your phone) It hasn’t gone out yet. It goes out by itself when there’s signal. Nothing. Wait.

Enviando (Sending) It’s on its way to the office right now. Nothing.

Esperando analista (Waiting for analyst) It reached the office. It still needs to be approved. Nothing. If it’s urgent, let someone know.

Retenido (On hold) The office held it because of the customer’s credit. Collect what they owe and, if you didn’t do it during the visit, request approval.

Confirmado (Confirmed) Approved. The order goes to dispatch. Nothing. Done.

Cancelado (Canceled) The office voided it. Ask why.

Sin stock (Out of stock) There isn’t enough of some product. Open it and decide what to do.

Rechazado (Rejected) The office rejected it. Sending it again won’t help. The order shows you the reason Odoo gave, word for word — for example, that this company doesn’t allow liquor to be mixed with other products — and the alert you receive says the same. Read the reason and rebuild it the way it says.

No se envió (Not sent) It was tried many times and didn’t go out. Tap «Reintentar» (Retry) or let someone know.

The chips at the top group these same statuses: «Todos» · «Abiertos» · «En proceso» · «Con analista» · «Retenidos» · «Confirmados» · «Cancelados» · «No se enviaron» (All · Open · In progress · With analyst · On hold · Confirmed · Canceled · Not sent).

Heads up
If an order says «En tu teléfono» (On your phone) for a long time, don’t enter it again. It already exists. Get online for a moment and it goes out by itself.

### What you can do with an order

Tap the card to open the details. Depending on where it stands, different buttons appear at the bottom.

Action When it appears What it does

Repetir este pedido (Repeat this order) On any order that’s already at the office and has lines. Opens a new one with the same products and quantities, so you can adjust it and send it. It doesn’t duplicate the old one: it’s a separate order.

Editar pedido (Edit order) Only while it’s «Con analista» (With analyst). You change quantities and the note. Once it’s confirmed it can’t be touched: that’s the office’s call.

Cancelar pedido (Cancel order) As long as the office hasn’t confirmed it. Voids it and releases the stock it had reserved.

Nuevo pedido a este cliente (New order for this customer) Always. Starts one from scratch for that customer, without copying anything.

Conversación (Conversation) On every order that has reached the office. Talk to whoever is reviewing it. See [Talking to the office](https://zentrix.company/en/sales/docs/conversacion.html).

Don’t get this wrong
Canceling can’t be undone. If the customer wants it later, you have to build it again.

And there are two different kinds of cancellation, even though the button has the same name:

- If the order is still on your phone, canceling it deletes it from there and the office never knew it existed.

- If it has already arrived, it’s voided there. And if the office already confirmed it, it can’t be done — the app tells you on the spot.

### If it bounced for lack of stock

When you build an order without signal and, by the time it goes out, there isn’t as much available as you ordered, the order bounces. It’s almost never lost: the office tells you how much is left of each product.

On the bounced order, here in Actividad › Pedidos (Activity › Orders), tap «Ajustar» (Adjust): you lower the quantities to what’s available and send it again. You ordered 20 and there are 6 left: six cases sold beat none.

- Prices don’t change. They’re still the ones you quoted the customer.

- It’s the same order, with different quantities — not a new one. That’s why nothing gets duplicated even when it’s resent.

### Visits

Everything you’ve visited is here. The chips are «Todas» · «Hoy» · «Con pedido» · «Sin pedido» · «Abiertas» (All · Today · With order · Without order · Open).

The two that depend on you always sit at the top of the list:

- «Quedó abierta» (Left open) — you checked in and didn’t close it. Tap it to finish it.

- «Cerrada, por enviar» (Closed, to send) — you closed it properly and it’s waiting for signal to go out.

### Returns

The goods a customer returned to you. Every return starts in step 5 of a visit and shows up here with its reference number, the date, the products and how many units it has.

The counters at the top: where each return stands.

Search by customer, RIF, reference or product — it’s how you answer “what about that case of whisky I returned to you?” without leaving the screen. The chips are «Todas» · «Por enviar» · «En la oficina» · «Recibidas» · «Canceladas» (All · To send · At the office · Received · Canceled).

Don’t get this wrong
«En la oficina» (At the office) is not «Recibida» (Received).

- «En la oficina» means the return arrived and was logged, but the warehouse hasn’t counted the goods yet.

- «Recibida» means the warehouse has checked it and accepted it.

While it says «En la oficina», don’t promise the customer they’ve been credited anything.

### Picking up the goods

When the goods need to be picked up from the customer, the return also carries the pickup status: a pill on the card and in the details that tells you how it’s going. This is the path it follows, and the exact name of each status is set by the office:

It says What it means

Retiro por aprobar (Pickup pending approval) You requested it and it’s waiting for the Sales Manager to approve it.

Retiro rechazado (Pickup rejected) It wasn’t approved. In the details, at the top and in red, is the reason. If the office didn’t write one, the app says so and tells you to ask in the conversation.

Retiro aprobado (Pickup approved) Approved. Logistics still needs to schedule it.

Retiro programado (Pickup scheduled) It now has a date to stop by the store.

Mercancía retirada (Goods picked up) They’ve been collected from the customer.

Recibida en almacén (Received at warehouse) · Auditada (Audited) It reached the warehouse and they’re counting it.

Devuelta (Returned) The warehouse accepted it.

Nota de crédito emitida (Credit note issued) Done: the customer has been credited. Now you can tell them.

The colors help you read it at a glance: red for rejected, amber for in progress, green for finished.

- When it’s approved or rejected, you get an alert, and tapping it opens that return.

- The list filter shows a «Retiro» (Pickup) section: «Por aprobar» · «Rechazado» · «En proceso» · «Devuelto o acreditado» (Pending approval · Rejected · In progress · Returned or credited). It only appears if one of your returns has a pickup.

- If the office canceled the return, the card says «Cancelada» (Canceled) in red, even if the pickup was left at “approved.” Don’t wait for any truck.

- Returns that are still on your phone don’t have a pickup yet: that starts when they reach the office.

A detail worth knowing
If something says «Por enviar» (To send) or «No se pudo enviar» (Couldn’t be sent), it’s still on your phone. The first fixes itself once there’s signal; the second needs a look. Tap the card to see the reason.
